run_token_classification_pipeline: run a token classification pipeline to extract named entities from text using a pretrained NER model
test_aggregation_strategies: test all aggregation strategies including simple, first, max, and average on token classification outputs
test_chunking_with_stride: test chunking long sentences into smaller segments with a configurable stride for token classification
test_pre_tokenized_inputs: test the pipeline with pre-tokenized word lists using the is_split_into_words flag
test_argument_handler: test the TokenClassificationArgumentHandler for parsing inputs, offset mappings, and error cases
